name: rheon
description: Package manager for the rheon tools.
author: takakix2
notes:
Package manager for the rheon tools. Fetches pipes and the declarations that turn them into dot-verbs.

`verbs` holds only the short name `rh` -- a plain alias (`rh install rheon-eye`), not a dot-verb: a dot-verb is for a pipe that carries records through a chain, and this is the tool that *installs* those pipes, so it has nothing to put on the wire. `rh` was checked free on Ubuntu, Debian, Homebrew and npm (a dormant crates.io HTTP client installs an `rh`; rheon does not overwrite a shelf name it did not put there). It also deliberately does not claim `profile: rheon-cli/v1` -- that profile is for producers and transforms, and requires stdout to hold records only, whereas this talks to a person. Install it and type `rheon ...` or `rh ...`.
